name: Acerinox, S.A.
summary: Acerinox, S.A., through its subsidiaries, manufactures, transforms, and markets stainless steel products in Spain, the Americas, Africa, Asia, Oceania, and rest of Europe. The company's Flat Stainless Steel Products segment offers billets, black coil, circles, cold rolled coil and sheet, engraved coil/sheet, hot rolled coil and sheet, plates, and slabs. Its Long Stainless Steel Products segment provides angles, bars, black bar, cold rolled and hot rolled reinforcement bar, color coated wire, hexagonal wire rod, hot rolled reinforcement coil, peeled bar, profiles, reinforcement wire, wires, and wire rods. Acerinox, S.A. was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in Madrid, Spain.
